lcc_original: 但是我要同你立約。你要進樓船；你和你兒子，妻子跟兒媳婦，都要同你進去。
notes: LCC restructures the single Hebrew clause (enter-ark + compound subject list) into two sub-clauses: 你要進樓船 and 你和你兒子…都要同你進去; all SNs distributed across both sub-clauses accordingly
WH0413 (אֶל, into/to) has no explicit counterpart in LCC's 進樓船; attached to 樓船 since the directional preposition is absorbed into the verb-noun compound
WH0859 (emphatic אַתָּה) placed on the 你 that heads the family list, not on the introductory subject 你要進樓船, matching Hebrew's appositive structure
LCC lists family in order sons→wife→daughters-in-law, matching Hebrew word order (בָנֶיךָ / אִשְׁתְּךָ / נְשֵׁי-בָנֶיךָ); UNV lists wife first—SN assignment follows LCC's own sequence
Second 進 in 都要同你進去 left unannotated; it is LCC's structural repetition of the entry verb, not a second Hebrew occurrence of H935
